name: CUBESCAPE
description:
About This Game

CubeScape is a first-person atmospheric experience about self-reflection, perception, and a vanishing reality.


You enter a gallery named Tesseract, but soon the exhibits fade, the walls collapse, and you’re left wandering strange cubic worlds — each obeying its own logic.

Explore surreal spaces, interact with mysterious objects, trigger mechanisms, and uncover symbolic links between your surroundings and your inner self. This journey won’t give you clear answers — it will make you ask the right questions.

Key Features:

  • First-person exploration with full movement freedom

  • Interact with objects, activate mechanisms, affect the world

  • Story told through space and sound — no dialogue, no HUD

  • Philosophical themes: memory, perception, inner transformation

  • Surreal, dreamlike environments built on geometric abstraction
short_desc: You look at the painting. But you don’t know — it’s him. A man who once loved, suffered, believed. Now he hangs on your wall. He doesn’t breathe. He doesn’t remember. But his gaze… it’s still there.
